newsitem.title: CHINA: China to cut cotton processing capacity in 96-97.
newsitem.headline: China to cut cotton processing capacity in 96-97.

text.p: China is to reduce cotton processing capacity in the next two years in an effort to curb oversupply of primary processing of cotton products, the Xinhua News Agency said on Monday.
Mills ordered to reduce production would be those in major cotton-producing cities in China, Wu Wenying, president of China's National Textile Council, was quoted as telling in a national conference.
He said uncompetitive mills should restructure themselves through mergers, bankruptcy or switching to other products.
China would also try to clear out some excess silk manufacturing capacity in the next year, Wu was quoted as saying.
New projects in the chemical fibre industry should be under strict control, he said.
